name: Integer Arithmetic
description: Adding, subtracting, multiplying and dividing whole numbers.

name: Negative Numbers
description: Operations with negative numbers and sign rules.

name: Order of Operations
description: Brackets, powers, multiplication/division before addition/subtraction.

name: Fraction Operations
description: Adding, subtracting, multiplying and dividing fractions.

name: Exponent Rules
description: Product, quotient and power rules for exponents.

name: Variables & Expressions
description: Using letters to stand for numbers and evaluating expressions.

name: Distributive Property
description: Multiplying a factor across every term inside brackets: a(b + c) = ab + ac.

name: Combining Like Terms
description: Adding terms with the same variable part.

name: Balancing Equations
description: Doing the same inverse operation to both sides of an equation.

name: Ratios & Percentages
description: Expressing parts of a whole as ratios and percentages.

name: Algebraic Manipulation
description: Rewriting expressions by expanding, collecting and simplifying.

name: Linear Equations
description: Solving equations of the form ax + b = c, including with brackets.

name: Factoring
description: Writing an expression as a product, the reverse of expanding.

name: Expanding Products
description: Multiplying out products of brackets such as (x + a)(x + b).

name: Linear Inequalities
description: Solving inequalities and flipping the sign when multiplying by a negative.

name: Linear Graphs & Slope
description: Gradient, intercept and the equation y = mx + c.

name: Simultaneous Equations
description: Solving two linear equations together.

name: Rational Expressions
description: Simplifying and combining algebraic fractions.

name: Quadratic Equations
description: Solving equations involving x squared.

name: Polynomials
description: Adding, multiplying and simplifying polynomials.

name: Functions
description: Function notation, domain, range and composition.

name: Quadratic Formula
description: Solving any quadratic with the formula and the discriminant.

name: Exponential Functions
description: Growth and decay functions of the form a·b^x.

name: Limits
description: The value a function approaches as its input approaches a point.

name: Derivatives
description: Rate of change and the power rule.
